messages.subject: Pump shaft HX (part:320070) - revised packages incl. faster payment
messages.body:
Dear Ms Fuchsreiter,

Thank you for your improved offer. We value your quality record and would like to place the HX shaft with you.

Stainless input costs have eased. AS-14404 fell from 3182.67 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06) to 3007.80 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a change of -5.49%. PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%. PPI-D351 fell from 140.5 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11) to 123.7 (idx:PPI-D351@2026-04), a change of -11.96%.

You asked us in September to pay faster. One attached package therefore offers 14-day payment. All packages cover 4200 pc per year over 24 months. Could you make your preferred package your standing offer?

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Pump shaft HX (part:320070) - revised packages incl. faster payment
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. I looked at the material indices you sent and you're right, costs dropped a bit, so I'm passing that on. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351.

Hallo, thanks for the 14-day payment option, that really helps us out right now. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. 

I can do €29.00 per piece with 14 days payment and 28 days lead time. So, our offer is a price of €29.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

Gruß
Claudia Fuchsreiter
Owner, Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH
